name: Recap
description: Ends a long agent turn with a short recap of what it actually did — the work, the files and commands it named, what it could not finish, and the obvious next step — written by a side model so the main answer is left untouched. Long turns only by default (short answers recap themselves). `/recap` recaps the whole conversation on demand without spending a turn on the main model; `/recap off` mutes the automatic one for that chat.
tagline: A short recap of what the agent just did

slash_commands.description: Recap the conversation so far — what was done, what changed, what is still open. `/recap off` mutes the automatic per-turn recap in this chat, `/recap on` restores it.

fields.label: Recap long turns automatically
fields.description: Summarize what the agent did at the end of a turn. Off leaves `/recap` as the only way in.

fields.label: Recap turns longer than (characters)
fields.description: Turns shorter than this are left alone — a three-line answer is already its own recap. Default 1200; 0 recaps every turn.

options.label: Detailed — bullets plus what is still open

fields.label: Recap model
fields.description: Optional. Empty uses the local engine (or the node default).
